title: nist_lite round input
description: Evaluation knobs for one round. Episode instances are NOT in the round input: the referee derives every episode (task mix, start states, physics conditions) from the platform-injected SEED, which never enters the player sandbox.

episodes_per_stratum.description: Episodes per (K x clutter_bucket) stratum; 8 strata (K in {3,4,5,6} x {low,high}). Default 8 → 64 episodes/round.

deadline_ms.description: Per-control-step deadline for one batched /act call.

record_stride.description: Write a full trajectory for every Nth episode (0 = none).
